name: Rīga – Vakarbuļļi
notes: Riga's main kite beach (Daugavgrīva): wide sandy beach, shallow, wind waves in onshore winds. Also: Jūrmala beaches (e.g. Bulduri) on the Gulf of Riga, shallow sandbars.

name: Liepāja
notes: Open Baltic beach: waves in W winds, for confident riders in strong wind.

name: Ventspils
notes: Open Baltic beach south of the harbour mole: waves in W winds.
